Yes, I just mailed the formal letter to your personal email. Total gross remuneration will be LKR 95,000 (basic 70,000 + fixed transport 25,000) with EPF/ETF. Pls review and sign the attached digital document.
Received it. I read through the terms and everything looks clear. Signed and uploaded back via the secure portal.

Received, thank you! Now that the contract is executed, our finance team needs your salary disbursement details. Could you email a scanned copy of your bank book front page or an e-statement showing your account number & branch name to payroll@zenithlogistics.example?
Sure, does it have to be a specific bank or can I provide my existing savings account at any commercial bank?
Any registered commercial bank under your name is fine. We just need to verify the account holder name matches your NIC before next month's payroll cutoff. Thanks Malith!
Understood. Sent the document over email just now. Thanks for the guidance!

messages.text: Hi Kasun, Nilwala Super Mart Nugegoda branch eken katha karanne. Oya part time cashier post ekata apply karala thibba neda?

Heta puluwan sir. Address eka High Level road branch ekamada?
Ow No. 142 High Level Rd, Nugegoda. Entrance eke security ta kiyanna HR manager meet wenna awe kiyala. CV ekath ekka NIC copy ekak aran enna.
Ela sir. Hourly rate kohomada wenas wenne probationary period eke?
Normal rate Rs. 650 per hour + night travel allowance denawa 10pm nisa. Ewa okkoma interview eke explain karannam. Contact no: 07X-XXX-XXXX if lost.
Clear sir, mama 10.15 AM weddi ethanata ennam. Thanks!

messages.text: Dear Anuki, Thank you for applying for the 2025 Graduate Trainee Programme at Dambulla Agro Holdings. Your application passed our initial screening stage.
Dear Mr. Perera, Thank you for the update! Glad to know my application was shortlisted.

As the next phase, all candidates are required to take our 45-minute timed aptitude test (numerical reasoning + problem solving). You can take it directly on our assessment portal: https://careers.dambulla-agro.example/portal/assessment?ref=GT2025
Got it. Is there any deadline to complete this test?
Yes, please submit before Friday 6:00 PM. Make sure you use a laptop with a stable internet connection. No webcam proctoring is needed, but once started, timer cannot be paused.
Will do. Just to verify, is there any fee or registration payment required for this assessment?
Absolutely not. Our recruitment process is entirely free. Log in with your application email only. Good luck!
Perfect, thank you! I will attempt it tonight after work.

messages.text: Hi Tharindu, this is Nilmini from SmartLearn Education Hub. Saw your application for the part-time Cambridge O/L Math tutor role.
Hello Nilmini madam, yes I applied through the job board last week. Thank you for reaching out!
Great. We have two batches open at our Battaramulla branch on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 4:30 PM to 6:30 PM. Would those hours suit your schedule?
Yes, Tuesdays and Thursdays are totally fine. I finish campus lectures around 2 PM so I can easily travel there.
Perfect. Regarding the compensation, we pay Rs. 2,200 per hour. Pay is calculated at the end of each month based on your signed attendance log, paid directly to your account on the 5th.
Rs. 2,200/hr sounds very fair. Do I need to prepare lesson handouts myself or does the institute provide materials?
We provide the syllabus guide and past paper booklets, but you can create your own quick notes if needed. You can review our tutor handbook here: https://smartlearn-portal.example/guidelines
Understood, checking the link now. Once I look it over, what are the next steps?
Could you drop by this Saturday at 11 AM for a 15-minute mock teaching session on Quadratic Equations? If that goes well, we will issue the agreement.
Sure thing, I will prepare the lesson and be there by 10:45 AM. Thank you!

messages.text: Good morning Dinithi, following up on your final interview for the Junior Logistics Coordinator position at Apex Ceylon Freight.
Good morning! Hope you are doing well. I was eagerly waiting for your update.
The panel was quite impressed with your analytical assessment. We would like to extend a formal offer. Our proposed gross salary is LKR 85,000 plus standard company medical insurance.
That is wonderful news! I am very happy to accept this package.

Before we release the appointment letter, we require your consent for reference checks and criminal record clearance. Please submit the digital authorization form here: https://apexceylon.example/onboarding/consent
Noted. Does the form require my previous employer contact or Grama Niladhari certificate details?
Both, plus your national identity number. Once submitted, background clearance typically takes 3 working days. Are you still able to join us on October 2nd?
Yes, October 2nd works perfectly as I have already served my two weeks' notice. Filling out the portal form right now.
Excellent. Once HR flags the clearance as verified, our manager will email you the official contract and reporting details. Welcome aboard!

messages.text: Hi Oshadi, this is Dr. Senanayake from BrightMinds Academic Institute in Kandy. We reviewed your profile for the Part-Time Chemistry Revision Teacher opening.
Good evening Sir. Thank you for getting back to me. I have been teaching local A/L syllabus chemistry for about two years privately.
That's exactly what we need. Our scheduled slots are Saturday afternoons 2:00 PM to 5:00 PM and Monday evenings 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM. Are you comfortable with those hours?
Yes Sir, both slots fit into my schedule. How does the remuneration work?

We pay an hourly rate of LKR 2,800. After every class session, you enter your topic covered and hours into our internal tutor tracking tool at https://brightminds.example/timesheet, and payouts are credited every alternate Friday.
That sounds very structured and convenient. Do I need to submit bank account details in advance?
Yes, once you sign the appointment contract, our accounts division will need a cancelled cheque or account statement header from any local bank in your name for direct credit.
Understood. When would you like me to come in for the syllabus briefing?
Please visit our Kandy branch on Friday at 3:00 PM. Bring your degree transcripts and national identity card copy.
Will do, Sir. Thank you very much, see you on Friday.
